timing_declaration.statement: This specification was written and committed BEFORE running the Agent-3 multi-seed validation campaign and BEFORE any of its outcomes were observed. It supersedes no physics; it fixes analysis endpoints and decision rules in advance.
existing_artifacts_seen_before_preregist: research_data/e11_validation_sweep.json (10 seeds; gain does NOT hold)
timing_declaration.consequence: Existing criteria that were defined after Phase-1/2 results were seen are relabeled 'exploratory_confirmed'. All primary criteria below are NEW prospective criteria.

statistics_convention.note_on_trials: Episodes/trials within one seed are repeated measures on one physical trajectory and one brain draw; they are NEVER counted as independent replicates.
statistics_convention.seed_rule: seed_k = seedBase + k*101, k = 0..n-1 (matches experiment_core.runBenchmark and apparatus batch runners)
statistics_convention.ci: mean +/- t(0.975, n-1) * sd/sqrt(n) over per-seed values (t-based, not normal approx)
statistics_convention.bootstrap_ci: BCa-style percentile bootstrap (10000 resamples of seeds) reported alongside for small n
statistics_convention.permutation_test: seeded label permutation on per-seed values; 10000 draws for unpaired, 10000 sign-flips for paired; exact for n<=8; PRNG seed 20260920
statistics_convention.effect_size: Hedges' g (small-sample corrected) for mean contrasts; rank-biserial r for the permutation framework
statistics_convention.multiple_comparisons: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR (q=0.05) within each experiment's primary+secondary family; Holm correction across the 5 flagship primary tests reported additionally
statistics_convention.directionality: all tests two-sided; one-sided success requires the pre-declared sign

E3.title: Drosophila-inspired MB network on the door task

arms.drosophila_frozen: same controller, learning disabled from trial 0 (NEW control arm; wrapper forces setLearning(false))
arms.classical_demon: classicalDemon (reference policy only, never the learning claim)

E3.independent_replicate_unit: seed (env PRNG seed+k*101, controller PRNG seed^0x5f5f)
E3.training_window: trials [0, 300) of train phase, 12 s episodes
E3.test_window: all test-phase trials (60), 12 s episodes, learning flag off

primary_endpoint.metric: goodBadRatio (per-trial good/bad crossings; trials with 0 bad crossings excluded, exclusion count reported per seed)
primary_endpoint.contrast: paired learning gain: per-seed mean(late train block, last 20% of train trials) - mean(early train block, first 20%) for arm drosophila

secondary_endpoints: test-phase goodBadRatio, drosophila vs random (unpaired permutation)
test-phase goodBadRatio, drosophila vs drosophila_frozen (unpaired permutation)
test-phase dTfinal, drosophila vs random
test-phase sortEntropy (sorting delta, bits), drosophila vs random
test-phase openFraction, drosophila vs random
E3.reference_metric_warning: demonAgree is REFERENCE-RELATIVE (self-referential for classical_demon, which agrees with itself by construction). It is reported as a secondary/reference metric only and can never support a learning claim.
E3.success_criterion: primary contrast > 0 AND BH-FDR-adjusted permutation p < 0.05 AND Hedges' g >= 0.5
E3.failure_criterion: primary contrast <= 0, or adjusted p >= 0.05, or g < 0.5 while adjusted p >= 0.05 (report as 'direction consistent, evidence insufficient')

E4.title: Connectome-constrained demon 4A/4B/4C (+frozen)

arms.connectome_4C: shuffled connectome (degree-preserving target permutation), plasticity full, opticDrive 0.25
arms.connectome_frozen: full connectome, plasticity none (NEW control arm)

E4.independent_replicate_unit: seed for 4A/4B/frozen; for 4C the unit is the (shuffle-draw, seed) cell - shuffle draws k=0..9 use shuffle seed 1000+k*17, seeds use seedBase+k*101; 4C condition-level inference uses shuffle-draw means

shuffle_control.degree_preserving: out-degree and per-source weight multiset exactly preserved; in-degree exactly preserved; edge SIGN travels with the edge (per-target sign composition NOT preserved - disclosed)

primary_endpoint.question: does the connectome itself contribute measurable performance beyond topology-free wiring?

secondary_endpoints: connectome_4A vs connectome_4B (plasticity scope effect) on test goodBadRatio
connectome_4A vs connectome_frozen (learning effect) on test goodBadRatio
connectome_4A learning gain (late-early train goodBadRatio, paired)
test dTfinal and sortEntropy, 4A vs 4C
test miNeural, 4A vs 4C (proxy; binarized spike-count MI)
E4.control_condition: connectome_4C (degree-preserving shuffled) is THE control; connectome_frozen isolates plasticity
E4.success_criterion: primary contrast > 0 AND BH-FDR-adjusted permutation p < 0.05 AND Hedges' g >= 0.5
E4.failure_criterion: contrast <= 0 or adjusted p >= 0.05 => 'connectome structure contributes no measurable performance in this regime' (reported verbatim if it happens)

E9.title: Pressure demon (valve + piston)

arms.demon_neural: FAFB connectome brain, learning on during train episodes
arms.demon_frozen: same brain factory, learning off from episode 0
arms.demon_speed: classical speed-selective valve REFERENCE policy (never treated as a learned neural controller)
arms.demon_random: random valve p(open)=0.3, two-way passable (no-information control; NOTE: also differs in rectification direction - disclosed)

E9.independent_replicate_unit: seed (one gas + one brain draw per seed); episodes are repeated measures (piston/gas persist across episodes within a variant)

primary_endpoint.metric: workJEp (per-episode spring work, signed units x 1e-21 J)
primary_endpoint.contrast: paired per-seed test-phase mean: demon_neural - demon_frozen

secondary_endpoints: test-phase reward (neural - frozen)
test-phase decisionAccuracy (neural - frozen)
test-phase dPfinal (pressure differential proxy, neural - frozen)
test-phase pistonX and openFraction (neural - frozen)
test-phase goodCrossings - badCrossings (net selection, neural - frozen)
floor check: demon_neural workJEp vs never_open (loop-alive sanity, unpaired)
reference context: demon_speed on all metrics (not part of any learning claim)
E9.control_condition: demon_frozen (exposure-matched, same brain draw); never_open and demon_random as policy-free floors
E9.classical_policy_status: reference only. It may exceed the neural controller; that is a benchmark of the fly brain, not evidence against the physics.
E9.success_criterion: primary paired contrast > 0 AND BH-FDR-adjusted sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 AND Hedges' g >= 0.5
E9.failure_criterion: contrast <= 0 or adjusted p >= 0.05 => 'no measurable plasticity benefit on useful work'; if the floor check also fails, flag 'loop not alive'

E10.title: Smoluchowski trapdoor

arms.trapdoor_frozen: same brain draw, learning off from episode 0

primary_endpoint.metric: netSorted = crossLR - crossRL per test episode
primary_endpoint.contrast: paired per-seed test-phase mean: trapdoor_neural - trapdoor_frozen

secondary_endpoints: test-phase directionalBias (neural - frozen)
test-phase decisionAccuracy (neural - frozen)
test-phase reward (neural - frozen)
test-phase densityDiff (neural - frozen)
test-phase holdFraction and pgReleaseP (mechanism descriptors)
back-leak accounting: crossRL per test episode (neural vs frozen)
physics context: trapdoor_light vs trapdoor_heavy crossingRate and directionalBias (flap mass matters)
E10.control_condition: trapdoor_frozen (exposure-matched); physics variants quantify the uncontrolled flap
E10.success_criterion: primary paired contrast > 0 AND BH-FDR-adjusted sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 AND Hedges' g >= 0.5
E10.failure_criterion: contrast <= 0 or adjusted p >= 0.05 => 'no measurable plasticity benefit on net transport'

E11.title: Feynman ratchet & pawl (equilibrium bath)

arms.ratchet_neural: fly-brain pawl operator (learning on in train)
arms.ratchet_frozen: same brain draw, learning off from episode 0

primary_endpoint.metric: workJEp (SIGNED per-episode work against the load; backward rotation pays work back)
primary_endpoint.contrast: paired per-seed test-phase mean: ratchet_neural - ratchet_frozen
primary_endpoint.prior_expectation_disclosure: the earlier 10-seed sweep found the reward gain does NOT hold with seed-level CIs; a null result here is an expected possible outcome and will be reported as such

secondary_endpoints: test-phase reward (neural - frozen)
test-phase forwardSteps - reverseSteps (hop asymmetry, neural - frozen)
test-phase liftFraction (mechanism descriptor)
test-phase entropyProduction (MODEL-DEPENDENT bookkeeping; classified, not interpreted as measured entropy)
PHYSICS FACT CHECK A: ratchet_gradient mean netPerEpisode > 0 with t-CI excluding 0
PHYSICS FACT CHECK B: ratchet_equilibrium mean netPerEpisode <= 0 (no work extraction from one bath; back-driving expected)
PHYSICS FACT CHECK C: ratchet_heavy_load signed work lower than ratchet_gradient
E11.control_condition: ratchet_frozen (exposure-matched); equilibrium physics variant is the no-gradient control
E11.success_criterion: primary paired contrast > 0 AND BH-FDR-adjusted sign-flip permutation p < 0.05 AND Hedges' g >= 0.5
E11.failure_criterion: contrast <= 0 or adjusted p >= 0.05 => 'no measurable plasticity benefit on signed work at equilibrium'; physics fact checks failing => flag physics regression (blocks physics claims, not the learning claim)

thermodynamic_analysis_plan.rule: A PROXY or MODEL_DEPENDENT quantity is never reported as direct information thermodynamics.

planned_metrics.note: finite-reservoir upper bound, no engine implemented
k_B*T_env*ln2*measuredBits; bits are decision flips + crossing evaluations
transport directionality stands in for entropy change; no per-molecule entropy ledger
barrier-energy bookkeeping in an event-rate model, not measured heat
structurally 0 (no spatial particles); excluded from all inference

feedback_efficacy.definition: Sagawa-Ueda style feedback efficacy eta = <W>_feedback / <W>_no-feedback evaluated on the preregistered primary work/transport metric: E9 workJEp, E10 netSorted, E11 workJEp. W_no-feedback = frozen arm (same brain draw, no plasticity); the never_open / equilibrium physics arm provides the no-policy floor.
feedback_efficacy.interpretation: eta > 1 (CI excludes 1) means feedback (reward-gated plasticity) extracts more work/transport than the no-feedback bound under matched conditions. eta is DIMENSIONLESS and defined only when the no-feedback denominator is positive; otherwise reported as NaN with the reason.
feedback_efficacy.assumption_note: This is the formally defined ratio-of-expectations version of the Sagawa-Ueda efficacy for a feedback-controlled engine; it is computed on SIMULATED, MODEL_DEPENDENT work units and carries no claim about a physical demon.

thermodynamic_analysis_plan.no_feedback_comparison: every experiment reports the feedback (learning) arm against its frozen arm on the primary metric - this is the no-feedback comparison the efficacy ratio consumes

invariants: shuffled connectome remains degree-preserving and is actually wired into E4/E5 registries
connectome controller remains connected: brain output reaches the actuator (valve/door/pawl) in E9/E10/E11 and the door in E4
classical policy computes references only and never writes the actuator in neural arms
reward fields remain functions of physical state (work/crossings), not of success flags or phase
train/test separation: setLearning(false) is invoked for test phase in every learning arm
CI machinery aggregates per-seed values (never trial-level) and raises on single-seed input
